### Where it is available

**The vendor publishes no geographic restriction.** That is not the same as
confirming it is available where you are — check their terms before applying.

### Notes

Brevo publishes no founder-facing startup offer: https://www.brevo.com/startups/ 301s to this same partner page. The page is addressed to accelerators and VCs ('Offer exclusive discounts and advanced marketing & CRM tips to your members'), so a startup reaches the benefit only through an affiliated partner. No discount percentage, credit amount, duration, company age, funding or headcount criterion is published anywhere on the page. The form on the page is the partner sign-up, not a startup application. status_quote is taken from the page's own meta description.
